searchText: This is how it looks in the engine api: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/compare/master...nerolation:toni-consensus-specs:eip7928-block-access-lists The `block_access_list` comes from the CL alongside the `transactions` and others. Does ssz allows transmuting vector to native slice? ssz is little endian and fixed size items in vector are just appended Only fixed‐length Vectors can be cast to slices, dynamic Lists, as used inside BALs, are inside Containers and carry length/offset metadata, so you must parse them normally rather than transmute. I'm not an SSZ expert though, so would wait for someone to confirm.

Only fixed‐length Vectors can be cast to slices, dynamic Lists, as used inside BALs, are inside Containers and carry length/offset metadata, so you must parse them normally rather than transmute.
